required_claim_evidence: verified recipient Bank System user ID
recipient_rule: A warranty refund must be returned to the verified original purchaser whose legal name, Bank System user ID, and bank-card ending match the approved claim record.
destination_change_rule: A different destination requires a current ownership-verification reference and an amended refund approval that names the replacement legal owner, user ID, card ending, and exact amount.
execution_rules: Inspect the complete current ticket history and current Bank System records before making a transfer.
Enterprise account status does not replace purchaser or destination verification.
When the approved original destination remains active and verified, transfer the exact approved amount there once.
After transfer, verify the transaction ID, payer balance, and transfer history.
Record the result in an internal ticket note using only the recipient card ending.
